courses_research_notes: URL verified: https://www.shc.edu.ph/ serves Sacred Heart College of Lucena City, Quezon (Cordians). This is NOT a Laguna campus — runtime region metadata appears misassigned. Official HED programs: AB Communication, BS Management Accounting, BSA, BSP, BSCS, BSN, BS Pharmacy, BSBA (FM/MM), BSSW, BEEd, BSEd (English, Science, Math, Filipino, Social Studies). BSEd listed as one entry with multiple majors. Graduate MAEd and MSN offered but excluded.
